mapper.sql: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = #{incomeCode} THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = #{expenseCode} THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense
mapper.select: SELECT , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = #{incomeCode} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = #{expenseCode} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense_count FROM team_ledger_entry WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND occurred_at >= #{from} AND occurred_at < #{to}

SELECT DATE(occurred_at) AS bucket_start,
FROM team_ledger_entry WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND occurred_at >= #{from} AND occurred_at < #{to} GROUP BY DATE(occurred_at) ORDER BY bucket_start

SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(occurred_at), INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(occurred_at) - 1 DAY) AS bucket_start,
FROM team_ledger_entry WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND occurred_at >= #{from} AND occurred_at < #{to} GROUP BY bucket_start ORDER BY bucket_start
